_comment: Milestone 6: CSS selectors hidden per ticked Declutter option (plan §9). Keys match StudyBlocker.Common.DeclutterOption exactly. Pure CSS hides only — nothing here blocks navigation, so search, subscriptions, playlists and an opened video always stay reachable. YouTube's own DOM changes periodically; if a toggle stops doing anything, inspect the live page and fix the list here, not the code that reads it.
